Concept sheet drawn from the spec note's parts table (tools/blocky/sheet.py); blocky style rules: Blocky-Style.md
Parts (the note's table; mirror x makes an R and an L)
Face plate: `halo` (Legendary eye), 56 x 28 px at 32 a stud, 11 frames
Silhouettes at 64 px (black shape, each view in its own frame)
Element: Blizzard. VFX: touches the ground (Legendary, Effects.luau): a snow flurry of six
flakes circles its body (the Orbit at Body), frost ski-tracks trail between its skis (the Trail
from FrontL to FrontR), flakes drift down off its crest at 3 a second (the Emitter at Top) and
a cold periwinkle light hangs over the crest (pulse 3 s); every 10 s the gust (the flourish): a
burst of twenty-two flakes off its skis and a ring of frost rolling out on the ground (the
RingPulse at Feet); it hovers a little; in the rig the four wings beat, the crest crystals
glimmer, the ear tufts flick and the scarf end swings, and the gust lifts it in a hop and a
full turn with every wing flared and the scarf streaming
